walk_list.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
walk_list.construction: shared walk list: ell entries, each formed by one cursor/bound update, one table load, one store and one even-representative selection (P_walk_entry + P_even_form)

hprime_supply.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
hprime_supply.construction: H-prime supply for the shared walk list: one scan per entry per side (the SAME list is used by both sides, so the supply is charged twice, not nb times)

chain_tables.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
chain_tables.construction: digit-decomposition chain tables for the fixed-base step: sides x 2^d windows x 2^31 entries, each entry priced at one table load + one store

fixed_per_node.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
fixed_per_node.construction: per-base fixed setup: nb bases, each paying one routing + sort + group-scan pass

base_entry.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
base_entry.construction: record-window entry per base: sides x nb bases, each at the even-form price

walker_state.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
walker_state.construction: one walk cursor per base per side, 4 instructions per state (declared constant 4)

gap_point_tables.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
gap_point_tables.construction: gap-band point tables: sides x nb bases x 2^gap_support_log2 entries (the support is DERIVED in gap_support below from a union bound over DISTINCT gaps), 15 point operations per entry at the unit price

gap_self_check.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
gap_self_check.construction: self-check pass over the DISTINCT gap bands: ell-1 gaps (the walk list is SHARED, so repeated uses are not fresh draws and are not counted again)

gap_retry_worst.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
gap_retry_worst.construction: retry price: retry_draws x (q/(1-q)) x one discarded walk-list pass (ell x per_record_instructions), q = 1163388/100000000 from the banked per-regime CP-95 upper (0.01163388); the quotient is exact integer arithmetic with +1 ceil and the price granularity is ONE instruction (price 1)

candidate_scan_cap.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
candidate_scan_cap.construction: declared candidate cap 2^84 x 2^20 instructions per candidate (both are design constants, not cost-derived)

run_pair_cap.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
run_pair_cap.construction: declared run-pair cap 2^95 x 2 instructions per pair

root_and_io.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
root_and_io.construction: root extraction and IO: one scan per root test per side

root_scan_T.recompute: count x price, ceil; inputs are design constants only
root_scan_T.construction: final scan over the T table: one routing/sort/group pass per candidate root

records.recompute: sides x nb x ell records x per-record instructions
records.construction: 2*rps*2303 charged instructions per record (201 itemised + 233 charged overhead + 70 measured key-kernel instructions)

derivation_inputs: design-v33.json ONLY (constants + accepted price lattice); no row value is an input to any derivation
claim_vs_gate: OVER gate by 0.0268 bits -- DISCLOSED: the honest total is the honest total; rank is lost, validity is not

success.claimed_quantity: measured production-structure success probability, one-sided CP-95 LOWER endpoint (200000 trials, shared walk list, base x walk products, mu6 hit test)

poison_diagnostic_only.note: v32 claimed K_eff=0.508674 as if it WERE success; that is a collision intensity.  The Poisson map 1-exp(-K_eff)=0.398708 is printed here as a DIAGNOSTIC and is NOT the claim; the claim is the measured CP-95 lower endpoint above.

success.residual_disclosure: the fixture-to-production extrapolation (nb/ell split 2^16.35, 97-bit exponent sliver, 2^38 fixture order) is NOT claimed as transferable; the claimed number is the measured endpoint at the production STRUCTURE and no larger

gap_support.rule: P(max gap > 2^k) <= (ell-1) * exp(-2^k/mu)  [union bound over DISTINCT gaps]
gap_support.verdict: v32 put the FIXTURE ell=4774 into nb*ell and reported 31.377; with the production ell=2^70.650 the expectation is mu*ln(ell-1)=2^31.681 and the UNION BOUND at 2^33 gives abort probability 2^-105.6 < 2^-100, so 2^33 support entries are charged (2^32 in v32).  Repeated uses of a SHARED walk list are counted once, over the ell-1 distinct gaps.

kappa.provenance: max upper95 over the production-density cell, the canonicalised-uniform cell and the v32 uniform control
